ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located contiguous white field. A continuous, irregular black band follows the trailing edge. High-density black mottling is concentrated at the distal lateral tips (left and right points).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 45-55 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with distinct scalloped indentations of varying pixel depths.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending laterally, terminating in sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible circular high-contrast clusters at the distal tips indicating barnacle colonization. Two distinct dark circular 'rosette' scars are visible in the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, thin linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) visible across the white surface of both lobes, primarily oriented vertically or diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring on the right lobe likely from parasitic or barnacle attachment; significant barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips; irregular notches along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated small black punctate spots (freckling) scattered across the high-intensity white field of both lobes.
